newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot power mixed amid mild temps, lower gas.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot power mixed amid mild temps, lower gas.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices Friday in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were mixed against Thursday's levels amid forecast of very mild weather and falling natural gas prices.
Texas temperatures into early week would stay in the 60-70 Fahrenheit degree range and bottom in the 30s-50s, more than 10 degrees above seasonal norms.
Swing gas prices in south Texas dropped below $3.00 per million British thermal unit (mmBtu, off sharply from Thursday's $3.35-$3.45 range.
On the New York Mercantile Exchange, February Henry Hub gas futures fell 36.9 cents at $3.015/mmBtu after dropping more than 30 cents Thursday.
The absence of many ERCOT participants due to Christmas holidays kept bulk power trading light, marketers said.
ERCOT firm, peak power for a 16-hour block for Monday was quoted at $24.00-$28.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), a firmer range than Thursday's $22.00-$27.00.
A few ERCOT deals for Saturday to Monday delivery reportedly changed hands at $24.00.
ERCOT electricity for non-firm delivery during Monday's heavy load hours was assessed at $23.00-$27.00, up from Thursday's range of $20.00-$25.00.
Firm off-peak ERCOT deliveries for Monday were valued at $12.00-$13.00, down from Thursday's 14.00 for Friday.
ERCOT electricity for non-firm delivery during Monday's light load hours was notationally quoted at $11.00-$12.00, down from Thursday's $13.00.
"Everyone has plenty of coal-fired power (during off-peak periods)," a Houston marketer said.
Balance of December electricity in ERCOT remained steady in the $28.00-$29.00 range.
Market players said they expect daily ERCOT prices to unhinge next week when more normal level of trading resumes, and January natgas price indices are publish by Tuesday.
"Right now, I'm not very bullish on power or gas," said an ERCOT trader.
